readout.method: phone macro or USB microscope photo, one animal per image, scored blind by dish code

viability_check: day 3: count live fragments per dish; dead ones scored 'dead'
status: DRAFT: positive control NOT QUALIFIED under desk_threshold_rule_v1 (no scorable published Girardia rows); run only as a descriptive pilot, never as the gate
purpose: Descriptive pilot of the only published octanol protocol in a species hobby suppliers sell. Readout is head shape, not anterior-posterior polarity.

intervention.dose_units: 8 uL neat 1-octanol per 500 mL spring water (paper states 123 uM; by density this volume gives about 102 uM; the volume governs)
intervention.duration: 72 h with daily refresh, then plain water
intervention.description: 1-octanol bath in spring water after cutting, refreshed daily, as published

arms.citation: emmonsbell2015_ijms methods (wetlab/published_handling.csv): Girardia dorotocephala pre-tail fragments, 123 uM 1-octanol dispersed directly in spring water, 72 h with daily refresh, 20 C, scored about day 10; hexanol used as a control alcohol

intervention.description: spring water handled exactly like the octanol bath, refreshed daily

handling.stock: 8 uL neat 1-octanol into 500 mL spring water, mixed at least 30 min, remade each day for 3 days; microlitres, never millilitres
handling.exposure: 72 h with daily refresh, then plain water
deviations: the published hexanol control alcohol arm is omitted because its concentration is not stated; a sham-handling water arm replaces it

preregistered.min_penetrance_that_counts: none set: the sealed rule found no published rate to set it from; any threshold would be invented
